name: LGPD Consent | LGPD e Controle de Cookies
author: Fernando Filho

sections.description:
LGPD Consent shows a cookie consent notice to your site visitors and records their choices using cookies and the database.
It includes an admin settings page for customizing the banner and viewing consent logs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lgpd-consent folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the options under “LGPD Consent” in the admin menu.
sections.faq:
How does the plugin work?

The plugin displays a cookie consent notice on the front-end and stores the user’s response (accept or refuse) in the database.

How do I configure the plugin?

After activation, go to the “LGPD Consent” menu in the WordPress admin and adjust the settings as needed.

Why should I use this plugin?

It helps you move towards LGPD compliance by recording user consent and allowing a customizable cookie banner.
